propositions: The harness errored all 62 cells at fixture setup due to an ordering deadlock where Epic Link/Epic Name fields are only provisioned when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup.
The session-start readiness gate in wait_for_jira_dc_ready waited for Epic fields before any project existed, creating a deadlock where the gate blocked the action that could produce those fields.
Experiment 30981084637 proved the ordering defect by showing fields absent before project creation, unchanged after 180s of waiting alone, and present within 0.0512s of project creation.
The fix moves the Epic-field check to after project provisioning in _assert_project_capabilities and lowers FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S from 600s to 120s based on measured 0.0512s provisioning time.
The misleading decision rule in not_ready_message that attributed field absence to budget shortfall is rewritten to reflect the true provisioning precondition.
Live verification run 30982731669 achieved 62 passed, 1 xfailed, 0 failed, 0 errored cells end-to-end.
